# FUNkiness!

> FUNkiness! is an AI, social media and marketing agency based in Willemstad, Curaçao. We make the content, run the social media, build the campaigns and put AI to work for businesses on Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire and in the Netherlands. We keep the marketing plan for our clients and do the work, so they don't have to. Boring was never the plan.

- Founders: Daisy Kuipers and Berdien
- Based: Willemstad, Curaçao (Daisy is on the island; we meet clients in person anywhere on Curaçao)
- Works with: businesses on Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire and in the Netherlands, big or small
- Languages: English, Dutch
- Contact: sayhello@funkiness.ai, WhatsApp +599 9 675 1737
- Website: https://www.funkiness.ai
- Pricing: no fixed packages; every proposal is built around the client's budget

## Services

- [AI Marketing & Integration](https://www.funkiness.ai/ai-marketing-curacao): AI put to work in the business: faster content, quicker answers to customers, smarter workflows
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.funkiness.ai/social-media-marketing-curacao): social media made, posted and managed
- [Content Creation](https://www.funkiness.ai/content-creation-curacao): photo, video and copy created on Curaçao
- [Branding & Campaigns](https://www.funkiness.ai/branding-campaigns-curacao): brands and campaigns with an idea behind them
- [Marketing Strategy](https://www.funkiness.ai/marketing-strategy-curacao): we keep the plan, clients get one clear next step every month
